organ: stage by receipt: a level is earned by a gain on GATE, carried as a receipt anyone can re-run, and never printed
population: every tenth genesis card by serial, handed to its own demo owner; each gets three searches from the seeds its life names (seedsFor(head, 3)); the first that lifts its mind by 0.002 on GATE is signed in as a level

rules.claim: Every level earned re-runs exactly (both minds re-expressed on the same bytes give the receipt’s numbers) and deeply (the search it names, run again, finds the very mind it carries).
Five forgeries of every level — a raised score, a lowered start, another ground, another mind, another search — are each refused by the re-run.
Every leveled card is recorded by a registry only with the re-runner; without it, the registry refuses the level.
Levels earned on GATE hold on TEST: in at least 60% of levels, the new mind’s TEST AUC is above the old mind’s.
Across all levels, the mean TEST gain is above zero, with its bootstrap 95% lower bound above zero.
At least 25% of the sampled cards earn a level within their three searches.
